Wan 2.2 uses a different diffusion model for the first steps (high noise) vs the last steps (low noise).

This Workflow is set to gguf by default.

Remember to attach the nodes after!

The Florence Model will Automaticly generate a prompt.
 
Feel free to disable all of nodes in here if you think Florence its not helping.

-Set you seed, Steps and CFG

-Seed: If your are not having luck with your results, try changing the seed.

-Steps: More steps means better quality but longer generation time. Its set as "6" by defult. Fell free to change it and test new configurations. Use even numbers! 

-CFG: More CFG means better results but lognger generation time. Its set as "1.0" by default. Fell free to change it and test new configurations. Use values between "1" and "1.5".

Set The lenght of your video!

3sec - 49
4sec - 65
5sec - 81
6sec - 97
7sec - 113
Shift is set to "8" by default.  Feel free to change it and test new configurations.
